response.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_media_type_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(CAST(track_count AS REAL)) AS avg_media_type_track_count FROM per_media_type

assumptions.assumption: Tracks exactly at the size cutoff are excluded; the request does not specify whether the cutoff is inclusive.

alternatives.interpretation: Include tracks exactly at the size cutoff.
